# Ideal Bath Renovations - Comprehensive Knowledgebase

> Complete technical, service, and architectural documentation for Ideal Bath Renovations, Langley Township, BC.

## 2. Technical Specializations & Workmanship Standards
- **Schluter® Certified Waterproofing:** Every shower and tub surround is installed with continuous Schluter-KERDI / KERDI-BOARD waterproofing membranes, integrated curb transitions, and pre-sloped pans with 24-hour standing water flood testing.
- **Plumbing & Electrical Compliance:** Red Seal licensed plumbing for drain relocations, thermostatic valves, pressure-balanced shower controls, and certified electrical for GFCI circuits, LED accent lighting, and radiant floor warming.
- **Curbless Linear Drains:** Barrier-free shower entries using Schluter-KERDI-LINE stainless steel linear drains and porcelain tile envelopes, designed for seamless transitions and ADA/aging-in-place compliance.
- **In-Floor Electric Heating:** Schluter® DITRA-HEAT uncoupling membrane with integrated electric heating cables and programmable Wi-Fi thermostats for moisture-resilient subfloor isolation and thermal efficiency.
- **Custom Glass & Enclosures:** 10mm to 12mm heavy tempered frameless glass panels, sliding barn-door sliders, and custom matte black, brushed nickel, brushed gold, and chrome hardware.

## 3. Detailed Service Directory
1. **Full-Service Master Bathroom Remodeling (`/services/bathroom-remodeling`):**
   - End-to-end bathroom redesign, demolition, framing modifications, plumbing rough-in, electrical, drywall, tile, custom vanity, mirror, lighting, and fixture installation.
2. **Tub-to-Shower Conversions (`/services/shower-remodeling`):**
   - Replacement of standard 60x30 or 60x32 alcove acrylic bathtubs with custom walk-in tiled showers, frameless sliding glass, rainfall showerheads, and recessed storage niches.
3. **Walk-In Showers & Barrier-Free Suites (`/services/shower-remodeling`):**
   - Zero-threshold curb design with integrated bench seating, grab bar reinforcement, handheld wand fixtures, and anti-slip mosaic tile floors.
4. **Bathroom Tile & Stone Installation (`/services/bathroom-tile-installation`):**
   - Installation of large-format porcelain (12x24, 24x48), natural marble, chevron/herringbone patterns, stacked vertical subway tile, and epoxy or stain-resistant polymer grout.
5. **Custom Bathroom Vanities & Cabinetry (`/services/bathroom-vanity-installation`):**
   - Single and double sink vanities, engineered quartz tops with undermount ceramic basins, soft-close Blum hinges, pull-out organizers, and custom plumbing cutouts.
6. **Bathtub Replacement & Freestanding Tubs (`/services/bathtub-replacement`):**
   - High-gloss acrylic freestanding soaker tubs, alcove drop-in tubs, floor-mounted faucets, and integrated overflow systems.
7. **Bathroom Repairs, Restorations & Upgrades (`/services/bathroom-repair`):**
   - Water damage restoration, subfloor reconstruction, shower pan leak resolution, fixture modernization, and ventilation exhaust fan upgrades.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: How long does a full bathroom renovation take?**
  - A: A standard full bathroom remodel or tub-to-shower conversion typically takes between 7 to 14 business days, depending on tile customization and vanity fabrication.
- **Q: Are estimates free?**
  - A: Yes, Ideal Bath Renovations provides 100% free, detailed in-home written estimates with itemized material and labor specifications.
- **Q: What warranty is provided?**
  - A: We provide a comprehensive multi-year craftsmanship warranty alongside manufacturer warranties on Schluter waterproofing systems (up to 10-25 years), vanity cabinetry, and plumbing fixtures.
- **Q: How can I schedule an estimate?**
  - A: Call (672) 273-0434 or visit https://idealbathrenovations.ca/contact.
